headline_finding: Under strict one-to-one word-boundary evaluation, scalar GBT (F1=0.450) nearly matches CPC-context GBT (F1=0.458). The previously reported CPC-context F1=0.836 is the multi-resolution combined metric, which credits word-FPs aligning to phoneme boundaries. CPC is not required for the core segmentation pipeline.
architecture_implication: Production segmentation is CPC-free: PCEN+CRNN for calls in noise, scalar GBT for speech-like calibration. CPC retained only as optional human validation/diagnostic.
